title: String Compare
text: Compare two input strings, 2 inputs, 1 output, direct feedthrough; {Case sensitive} sets the case sensitivity for string comparison, {Compare Option} sets the amount of characters to compare Entire and {Number of characters}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Case sensitive
params.values: Case sensitivity for string comparison on (default) | off

params.name: Compare Option
params.values: Amount of characters to compare Entire string (default) | First N characters

params.name: Number of characters
params.values: Number of characters to compare 1 (default) | scalar
